metadata.description: No proof, no merge. Claude Code plugins for autonomous development in which the agent writes the PR and never grades its own work: interview-driven intake, outcome-gated build, review in a separate session, a model-free merge boundary, mutation-tested tests, cost on every PR, and a tool-call audit ledger. Generic tooling only; each consumer repo supplies one config file and optional knowledge files.

plugins.name: dev-pipeline
plugins.description: Autonomous ticket → intake → build → review → merge-boundary pipeline, gated by lean's five artifact milestones (outcome-gated blocks, portable merge-boundary evidence, tracker adapters github|jira).

plugins.name: review-toolkit
plugins.description: Multi-agent parallel code review: review-lead orchestration, reviewer-baseline protocol, and the generic reviewer panel.

plugins.name: intake-toolkit
plugins.description: Elicitation surface: intake front door, intake-interviewer, intake-orchestrator, plan-interview with Decision Ledger, grill-me, decomposition/spec reviewers.

plugins.name: design-toolkit
plugins.description: Design-fidelity toolkit: design-faithful translation/review skills and agents, with a config-selected design provider (figma or claude-design).

plugins.name: audit-toolkit
plugins.description: Session tool-call audit ledger: audit hooks, /audit and /audit-history query skills, self-tests.

plugins.name: second-shift
plugins.description: Onboarding + health for this marketplace: provenance-first /second-shift:onboard (writes consumer config, settings pin, lockfile), /second-shift:doctor (install-state verification), /second-shift:local-dev-refresh (machine-level plugin refresh). Install at user scope; it bootstraps everything else.
